units: Tosef. Sot. XV, 7 והטילוהו בק׳ they threw him into a furnace; Y. ib. IX, 24ᵇ top והחזירו לק׳ (read: והטילו).—Esp. the furnace room of the bath-house.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>אם המתין אדם בק׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אם ישהא … בחמין</he>) if a person stays in the furnace room any length of time; Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Thazriʿa 4 <he>נתין בקמון</he> (corr. acc.; Tanḥ. ib. 3 <he>בחמין</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 5:7">Tosef. Mikv. V, 7</cite> <he>המת במרחץ ק׳ טמא וכ׳</he> if a corpse lies in the bath-house, the furnace room is unclean &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:7">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>היו סותמין את הק׳ וכ׳</he> they used to stop off the furnace on Friday, and people went in and bathed &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:3">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 3</cite> Var. (v. <cite ref="J00578"><he>יֶקֶם</he></cite>); Y. ib. IV, 14ᶜ bot.
